gue_fortgrey_keeper.text: The Cup and Saucer, the locals call it. A round tower, built in 1804. The rocks round here have wrecked a great many ships, and the museum tells their stories: the Hanois lighthouse out on its reef, the lifeboats, and the ships that never made it round the corner.
Pull up a seat. If the tide's right, the sea comes right up round the rocks, and you'd swear you were on a ship yourself. Mind your head on the way out. The door was built for people who ate less.
